cost: O(n*min(m+1,2k+1)) time, O(min(m+1,2k+1)) space, two rows capped at 4096 cells each. Empty and difference-pruned cases are constant time. No full matrix. Standard allocator failure is not a typed error.
description: Let d be unit-cost byte Levenshtein distance, n=max lengths, m=min lengths. If n-m>t return None; if m=0 return Some(n). Otherwise k=min(t,n), w=min(m+1,2k+1) using saturation. If w>4096 return BandTooWide{cells:w}; else return Some(d) iff d<=t, None otherwise.

inverse: Some(v) retains every pair whose distance is v<=t and whose call is not a budget error. None retains all pairs with d>t outside the resource-error predicate. Error w retains all inputs satisfying the exact width predicate. ab/ac and xy/xz at t=1 both map to Some(1); None merges distinct distances. Lengths, bytes and edit scripts cannot be reconstructed uniquely.
